evidence: The SiyH stretching mode [2083 cm y1] redshifts to 2059 cm y1 and decreases in intensity. Only the hydrocarbonycontaining ligand [CyH peaks from the ethyl group at ~2900 cm y1] is observed (CO and Cp not detected). Upon exposing the surface to O 2 at 300˚C, this ethyl group attached during the first 0.5 cycle is removed, as expected for ALD growth.
